Discovers sitemap via robots.txt Sitemap directive

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'respect_robots_txt' => true }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.map_urls(engine, url)
puts result.inspect
```
